stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Daryl Baldwin - the club is glad to host Moore Park GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 12, 13 & 14 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 12, 13 & 14 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 3, 3-pointer on hole 4 - that's better

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 1 & 2 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: From the Movies
stories.detail: Blue Hinds found their happy place and rode it to 10 pts
